desc: 裸银旋口加内置茶仓，浓淡自握，冷白湿石冰蓝调性
leaf: 商务办公随身泡茶杯（平盖旋口、内置茶仓的彩壳水杯）
name: 冷白湿石内置茶仓泡茶杯款

shots.intent: 搜索结果一眼点击：两只不同配色的直身泡茶杯立在湿石台面上，裸银旋口与平盖轮廓讲清品类。
shots.textZone: upper left cold white field reserved for one short headline placeholder 「{selling_point_1}」 in #16252B with a 11pt letterspaced kicker line beneath

shots.intent: 一秒给出核心主张：六枚细线勾圈沿同一基线排开，替代源图的黑块图标，把卖点讲成可核对的视觉事实。
shots.textZone: headline placeholder 「{selling_point_1}」 centred at the top in #16252B, six short label placeholders 「{callout_1}」 to 「{callout_6}」 one under each tick circle

shots.intent: 把普通敞口杯茶渣糊口、分装麻烦的日常尴尬演出来，逼出内置茶仓与宽旋口的需求。
shots.textZone: upper right clean area reserved for one short pain headline placeholder 「{selling_point_1}」 in #16252B

shots.intent: 用两只同款杯的浅汤与久浸双态，把浓淡自握的机制讲成看得见的差别，不靠口头承诺。
shots.textZone: one short label placeholder 「{callout_1}」 above the left bottle and 「{callout_2}」 above the right, one thin centred hairline rule between them

shots.intent: 侧向微距证明旋口牙数、口沿与密封圈都是真实结构，把做工从形容词换成可见证据。
从正上方看进杯口，茶仓与滤孔的真实排布一次讲清分离机制，替代源图的图标化表述。
放进真实办公桌，让买家代入开会间隙单手开盖饮用的动线，完成自我投射。
shots.textZone: upper right cold white area reserved for one short scene headline placeholder 「{selling_point_1}」 in #16252B

shots.intent: 承接质检疑虑：同一光线同一距离的三格工艺特写，用可见做工代替源图无法核实的口号。
shots.textZone: three hairline tick circles numbered as caption markers with one short caption placeholder 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 under each panel, no body copy

shots.intent: 回答多大一握、能装几口这类规格疑虑，但只留占位标注栏位，数值由作者按真实参数填入。
shots.textZone: three short label placeholders 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 on the height, width and lid-height hairline leader lines, one short caption placeholder 「{selling_point_1}」 above a row of three tick circles

shots.intent: 把可选配色并排陈列让买家当场选定，缩略色卡承接源图红黑双色的选款逻辑。
shots.textZone: one short label placeholder 「{callout_1}」 centred under each row in #16252B

shots.intent: 以仰视的裸银旋口收住整套冷白调性，留一个干净的行动按钮完成收口。
shots.textZone: lower third reserved for one short call-to-action button placeholder 「{callout_1}」

style.backgroundSystem: one surface family per frame: a wet slate stone slab #AEBCC2 carrying real condensation beads and thin water films under a cold white upper field #F4F8FA for product screens; a #DCE9EE glass shelf edge with true refraction and caustics for mechanism and spec screens; flat #F4F8FA card panels with hairline rules for infographic screens; never a black stage, never an amber or warm mood, never a mixed or random environment
style.iconSystem: hairline 1pt circle outlines in #6EC0DE, each enclosing one single tick, evenly spaced on a shared hairline baseline; flat, no fill, no gradient; explicitly no rounded-square chips, no shield, trophy, fan or plug pictograms, no square tick boxes, no copper or gold rings, no 3D gloss icons, no real brand marks
style.lightingSystem: high-key 6500K top light placed straight down and slightly forward, so every shadow is short, crisp and sits directly under the base; brushed silver reads a tight vertical anisotropic grain band rather than a smeared gloss; glass and water read real refraction, edge darkening and caustic spill on the stone; condensation stays individually resolved, never painted-on; no warm cast, no long raking shadow, no contradictory light direction
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent high-key cold-white glass and brushed-silver drinkware ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cold white #F4F8FA, wet slate stone #AEBCC2, brushed silver #C4CCD1, glass shelf #DCE9EE, ink text #16252B and one ice-blue accent #6EC0DE; cool temperature held in every frame; high-key 6500K top light straight down and slightly forward so shadows are short, crisp and directly under the base, with tight anisotropic grain on brushed metal, true refraction through glass and water, individually resolved condensation beads and no warm cast; background system of one surface family per frame only, wet slate stone under a cold white field, a glass shelf edge for mechanism screens, or flat cold white cards with hairline rules for infographic screens; modern geometric sans-serif, Chinese in-image copy always wrapped in 「」, headline 30-44pt, kicker 11-13pt, label 10-14pt, sparse copy with no dense body text; icon system of hairline 1pt #6EC0DE circle outlines each holding one single tick, never rounded-square chips, never shield or trophy pictograms, never copper or gold rings; the slim tapered body with its flat cup lid and exposed brushed threaded neck keeps exact silhouette, taper and seal-ring placement, glass and metal render truthfully and never as opaque plastic, the label zone stays a clean unprinted field, the product is always grounded with a short contact shadow and never cropped at the base; every capacity, dimension, retention, material-grade, age and certification value stays a text placeholder; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented numbers, no certification or health claims, no brand marks or QR codes.

style.presentationRules: the same slim tapered body, its flat cup-shaped screw lid and its exposed brushed silver threaded neck keep their exact silhouette, taper, lid height, spout geometry and seal-ring position in every frame; transparent walls render as glass with refraction, colour-shelled walls render their real matte texture, brushed metal keeps directional grain, and none of it ever reads as opaque glossy plastic; the label zone stays a clean unprinted legible field with no brand mark and no readable characters; condensation and water level are physically believable; the product is always grounded with a short contact shadow, never floating, never cropped at the base; all capacity, dimension, wall-count, temperature-retention and material-grade values remain text placeholders and are never invented
style.surfaceSystem: wet slate stone #AEBCC2 and #DCE9EE glass shelf only, both with visible water beads and a believable contact line where the base meets the surface; a folded colourless microfibre cloth or a plain ceramic office mug may appear as the single scale anchor; nothing larger than the cup
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only; Chinese in-image copy always wrapped in 「」 and always a placeholder slot; headline 30-44pt, kicker 11-13pt letterspaced, label 10-14pt in #16252B on light screens and #F4F8FA on stone-dark screens; one hairline rule and one small kicker as the only ornament; sparse copy, never dense body text, no serif, no handwriting, no brush calligraphy
